title: Stream recording
description: Watched channels are probed on an interval and recorded automatically while live. Recordings enter the normal queue, never block other downloads, and can be stopped there at any time.
empty: No channels yet. Add a channel above and enable it to record automatically.

delete.title: Delete channel
delete.description: Delete "{name}"? Recordings already made are kept.

form.url_description: Page URL streamlink understands (Twitch, YouTube Live, …).
form.name_description: Used as the recording file prefix.
form.quality_description: Quality preset for this channel; default uses the global setting.
form.enabled_description: Probe this channel and record automatically while live.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.hint: A scheduled channel is watched only inside its window, so it does not record whatever else it happens to broadcast.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.timezone_hint: An IANA name such as Europe/Berlin, so the time stays right across daylight saving.
schedules.roll_hint: For a broadcast that starts early or overruns.
schedules.replay_hint: Only used where the provider actually offers it.
schedules.needs_channel: Add a channel above first — a schedule needs one to record.

recording.split_hint: A disconnect always starts a new part; this cuts on purpose as well.
recording.remux_hint: Parts are joined without re-encoding, as a resumable step.
recording.sidecars_hint: What the provider does not offer is reported rather than silently skipped.
